questions.budget: What are we allowed to spend, and where is the money going?
questions.plan: What are we going to do, when, and with whom?
questions.produce: What is actually happening, and are we delivering against plan and budget?

budget.title: Budget
budget.text: Build and version the budget; compare drafts side by side.

budget.title: Documents
budget.text: Quotation, funding plan or incentive file generated from the budget.

budget.title: Approve
budget.text: Client or funder signs; the working budget locks.

plan.title: Plan
plan.text: Crew, cast, locations and equipment set against the budget.

plan.title: Schedule
plan.text: Shoot days and prep on one timeline.

plan.title: Call sheets
plan.text: Daily call sheets shared to every phone.

produce.title: Costs
produce.text: Timesheets, purchases and invoices land as they happen.

produce.title: Control
produce.text: Approve, match to budget lines and update the forecast, the EFC (estimate for completion).

produce.title: Export
produce.text: Approved costs go to Xero or other accounting software.

produce: Export to Xero or other accounting software

budget.headline: A € 860,000 film, financed by funds and a cash rebate.
budget.text: The incentive only pays out on eligible spend. The budget has to prove it from day one.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: Eligible and non-eligible costs get mixed up; the rebate claim falls short.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: Funding and incentive lines live inside the budget. Eligible spend is tagged per cost line.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: Green ●. 100% financed, and the rebate report writes itself.

plan.headline: Three weeks to Day 1. Two crew contracts missing.
plan.text: Normally you find out on set. Here the hexagon turned amber this morning.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: 42/48 days placed, but contracts and the Day 1 call sheet lag behind.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: Any mismatch between schedule, contracts and call sheets flags the ⬢.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: Fixed before lunch. Shoot starts 5 Oct as planned.

produce.headline: Not rolling yet. The ▶ is still hollow.
produce.text: On 5 October it wakes up by itself: cost control opens on the first shoot day.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: Incentive claims are rebuilt after wrap from a shoebox of invoices.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: Every cost is tagged eligible or not as it lands. Forecast preset to € 860,000.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: The rebate claim is ready the day the shoot ends.

produce: Export to Xero or other accounting software

budget.headline: Six episodes, one quotation: € 1,240,000.
budget.text: Three budget versions compared, the broadcaster signed the quotation on v3 via DocuSign.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: The quote and the working budget drift apart per episode.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: Budget and quotation are the same document. Sign it, and it locks.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: Solid green ●. Every cost is measured against what was quoted.

plan.headline: 48 shoot days, 62 people, 14 locations. All confirmed.
plan.text: Call sheets shared through Day 21, straight to every phone.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: Long shoots: the schedule and the crew list stop agreeing.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: Days, crew, cast and locations planned against the budget.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: Plan and budget agree. The ⬢ stays green.

produce.headline: Day 17. “Are we still on budget?”
produce.text: The answer is on screen: forecast € 1,228,400, under budget.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: The forecast used to be a week behind.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: Timesheets and purchases land daily; forecast updates itself.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: 7 invoices in the queue, the rest already in Xero.

produce: Export to Xero or other accounting software

budget.headline: Harbour Lights spent € 12,400 before the quotation was signed.
budget.text: Nobody noticed until the broadcaster asked. In Tubes the “!” sits on the circle the same morning.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: Development costs against a draft quote, found a week too late.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: Unapproved costs flag the ● instantly. Fix the draft, send the quotation, get it signed.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: The circle turns solid. Series 2 starts on a quote everyone agreed to.

plan.headline: 60 shoot days pencilled in. Nothing booked yet.
plan.text: The hexagon stays hollow until the budget is approved. On purpose.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: Planning against a number that may change is how shows go wrong.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: Plan unlocks the moment the ● turns green.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: No rework. The schedule inherits the approved budget.

produce.headline: Not started. And that is the right status.
produce.text: Produce waits for Plan, Plan waits for Budget. The order is the point.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: Shows that start shooting before the plan is locked.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: Three steps, one direction. Each unlocks the next.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: A hollow ▶ that everyone understands.

produce: Export to Xero or other accounting software

budget.headline: Eight weeks on an island. € 1,780,000. No script.
budget.text: Unscripted means the budget has to bend without breaking.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: Contingency gets spent in week 2 and nobody sees it coming.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: Contingency is its own line. Every reallocation is a version, visible to the network.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: Green ●. v2 signed, and the network trusts the reshuffles.

plan.headline: The schedule changes every day. That is the format.
plan.text: Week 5 of 8. The hexagon is blue because planning never really stops.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: Daily changes to crew and locations never reach everyone in time.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: Change the schedule once; tomorrow’s plan updates on every phone.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: Active ⬢. 140 people, one plan, refreshed nightly.

produce.headline: 312 timesheets this week. Forecast: € 1,802,000. Watch.
produce.text: Over by € 22,000 and rising. The ▶ says so tonight, not at wrap.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: Big crews, daily overtime. The overrun surfaces months later.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: Timesheets and per diems land daily against the budget lines.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: Producer cuts two boat days in week 6. Back inside the number.

produce: Export to Xero or other accounting software

budget.headline: A commercial: € 310,000, four quotes, one week.
budget.text: Agency changes came fast. Each one became a new version of the quotation, not a new spreadsheet.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: Agency and client change daily; the quote rarely keeps up.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: Quote versions compared side by side. v4 signed, the rest kept for the record.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: Wrapped € 7,850 under. Margin visible from the first quote.

plan.headline: 24 shoot days, 3 locations, one crew.
plan.text: Every call sheet shared via the app. Nobody asked where to be.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: Short shoots leave no room for a missed call time.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: Crew, cast and locations confirmed against the budget; call sheets pushed out.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: 24/24 days delivered. Solid ⬢.

produce.headline: Wrap party and final cost report on the same day.
produce.text: 148 of 148 invoices approved. Every cost in Xero on 28 August.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: Closing the books used to take six weeks after wrap.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: Invoices approved as they arrive; approved costs export to Xero automatically.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: Books closed on wrap day. Margin known: 12.4%.

produce: Export to Xero or other accounting software

budget.headline: Six films for one client. One quote, three deliverables.
budget.text: € 145,000, signed. Margin visible before the first shoot day.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: Branded work gets quoted per deliverable; the total margin is a guess.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: One budget, one quotation, deliverables as lines. Client signs once.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: Green ●. Agency and client see the same number.

plan.headline: Six shoot days, four locations, booked in a week.
plan.text: The hexagon went green fast. Small productions move at agency speed.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: Fast turnarounds skip the plan; the shoot day becomes the plan.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: Locations, crew and call sheets set against the quote in one pass.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: 6/6 days planned. Client approvals logged in Plan.

produce.headline: Shoot starts 22 September. The ▶ is waiting.
produce.text: Every deliverable already has its cost lines. Day 1 lands in a live forecast.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: Small jobs skip cost control; the margin is found at invoicing.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: Produce opens on Day 1. Purchases and expenses land per deliverable.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: Margin per film known at wrap, not at year end.

Export to Xero or other accounting software

budget.headline: Twelve episodes, € 200,000 each. The same show, every week.
budget.text: A studio show is a template budget run twelve times. Tubes treats it that way.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: Episode budgets are copied by hand; a change in ep 3 never reaches ep 9.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: One episode template, twelve instances. Change the template once.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: Green ●. € 2,400,000 quoted, per-episode margin visible.

plan.headline: Same studio, same crew, every Saturday.
plan.text: The hexagon went green once and stayed there. Recurring plans should be boring.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: Weekly call sheets rebuilt from scratch, with the same mistakes.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: Recurring schedule; only guests and running order change per week.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: 12/12 studio days. Call sheet out every Thursday, automatically.

produce.headline: Episode 7 ran long. Overtime: € 9,800 over.
produce.text: The ▶ carries a “!” tonight. Five episodes left to make it back.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: Live shows overrun; the cost shows up in the crew invoices weeks later.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: Timesheets post per episode the same night. Forecast per episode and per series.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: Producer trims the ep 8 rehearsal. Series forecast back on budget.

budget.headline: Six weeks of rehearsal, forty shows, twelve venues. € 620,000.
budget.text: A theatre budget has two lives: the rehearsal period and the tour. Tubes keeps them in one place.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: Rehearsal costs and touring costs sit in separate sheets; venue fees change per stop.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: One budget with rehearsal and tour as sections; per-venue lines for fees and travel.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: Green ●. Funding, guarantees and box-office share visible in one number.

plan.headline: Forty shows in twelve cities. One schedule.
plan.text: Rehearsals, get-ins, performances and travel days on one timeline. The hexagon is green.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: Tour schedules live with the tour manager; the company finds out by email.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: Company, crew, venues and travel planned together; the daily schedule reaches every phone.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: 40/40 shows scheduled. Get-in times confirmed with every venue.

produce.headline: Show 14 of 40. Box office is tracking ahead of the guarantee.
produce.text: Per-show costs and settlements land the same night. The ▶ is blue.

beats.title: Problem
beats.text: Venue settlements arrive weeks later; nobody knows the tour result until it ends.

beats.title: In Tubes
beats.text: Settlements, per diems and travel post per show against the budget line.

beats.title: Result
beats.text: Forecast per venue and for the whole tour, updated nightly.
